containerDefinitions.name: db-verify
command:
set -eu
: "${PGPASSWORD:?}"
psql --no-psqlrc --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f - <<'V_SQL'
\echo '--- role attributes ---'
SELECT rolname, rolcanlogin AS login, rolsuper AS superuser, rolcreatedb AS createdb,
       rolcreaterole AS createrole, rolreplication AS replication, rolbypassrls AS bypassrls
FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'pronto_app';

\echo '--- privileges (verified as pronto_app itself) ---'
SELECT has_database_privilege('pronto','CONNECT')      AS connect_pronto,
       has_schema_privilege('public','USAGE')          AS usage_public,
       has_schema_privilege('public','CREATE')         AS create_public,
       has_database_privilege('pronto','CREATE')       AS db_create_must_be_false;

\echo '--- role memberships of pronto_app (expect zero rows) ---'
SELECT g.rolname AS pronto_app_is_member_of
FROM pg_auth_members m
JOIN pg_roles g ON g.oid = m.roleid
JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = m.member
WHERE r.rolname = 'pronto_app';

\echo '--- who holds admin over pronto_app (expect only the master) ---'
SELECT m2.rolname AS admin_holder, am.admin_option
FROM pg_auth_members am
JOIN pg_roles r2 ON r2.oid = am.roleid
JOIN pg_roles m2 ON m2.oid = am.member
WHERE r2.rolname = 'pronto_app';

\echo '--- btree_gist ---'
SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'btree_gist';

\echo '--- object ownership sanity: who owns the migrated tables ---'
SELECT tableowner, count(*) AS tables
FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' GROUP BY tableowner;

\echo '--- non-default roles present in the cluster ---'
SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname NOT LIKE 'pg\_%' ORDER BY rolname;
V_SQL
echo 'db-verify: completed'
